# simvyn

> Local mobile developer tools for iOS Simulators, Android Emulators, and supported physical devices, available through a web dashboard and CLI.

This index links to human-readable and agent-readable documentation. It does not install a skill or register tools. Device capabilities vary by platform and build type; read the installed CLI's help and the platform reference before running commands.

## Start here

- [README and installation](https://github.com/pranshuchittora/simvyn/blob/main/README.md): Requirements, dashboard features, and CLI overview.
- [Agent setup](https://github.com/pranshuchittora/simvyn/blob/main/docs/agents.md): Pi and portable skill installation, local checkout testing, output handling, and known limitations.
- [simvyn Agent Skill](https://github.com/pranshuchittora/simvyn/blob/main/skills/simvyn/SKILL.md): Entry point for agents using the existing CLI through their terminal tool.

## Task references

- [CLI commands](https://github.com/pranshuchittora/simvyn/blob/main/skills/simvyn/references/cli.md): Arguments and supported outputs.
- [Platform capabilities](https://github.com/pranshuchittora/simvyn/blob/main/skills/simvyn/references/platforms.md): Simulator, emulator, and physical-device constraints.
- [Workflow recipes](https://github.com/pranshuchittora/simvyn/blob/main/skills/simvyn/references/recipes.md): Practical device and application workflows.
- [Automation](https://github.com/pranshuchittora/simvyn/blob/main/skills/simvyn/references/automation.md): Bounded processes, verification, and Collections limitations.
